summary: The diff implements REQ-136 and REQ-137 via backend/migration.mo and backend/main.mo, and REQ-138 via frontend/src/components/BulkProductUpload.tsx. All required template content is present, the seeding logic exists, and the frontend component auto-selects the Default template and tracks manual edits. One partial concern exists: REQ-136 and REQ-137 require logic in backend/main.mo, but the implementation delegates to a separate migration.mo module, potentially violating the constraint that all Motoko logic must remain in the single backend/main.mo actor.

missing_requirements.requirement: All Motoko logic must remain in the single backend/main.mo actor — the Default template update/creation logic must be inside main.mo itself, not a separate module.
missing_requirements.reason: The build constraint states all Motoko logic must remain in the single backend/main.mo actor. The diff introduces backend/migration.mo as a separate module containing the template seeding and update logic. While main.mo imports and uses it, the logic itself resides outside the actor file.
